scope: Bybit-native BTCUSDT cost-sensitive nonlinear top-five limit-order-book forecast on a completed 100ms point-in-time clock. Stationary multi-level order-flow imbalance, queue shape, microprice, spread, update intensity, volatility, aggressive-flow, execution-adjusted withdrawal and refill are model inputs; no hand-coded cancellation/refill rule selects trades. Separate gradient-boosted models directly forecast executable 5/15/30-second BBO returns. Taker entry after 100/300/500ms, one global slot, adverse executable BBO stop, 12/18/24bp replay, 2022-07-01 fit and 2023-07-01 independent development; 2024-2026 prohibited.
non_overlap: PR #68 / CLM-20260726-0946-L2-CANCEL-REFILL-001 is a hand-specified 432-cell liquidity-pull and refill-failure rule screen across six 2023 dates. This claim does not select trades with those rules: it fits nonlinear cost-sensitive multi-horizon return models on stationary full-book and event-flow features, uses 2022 as the only fit partition and evaluates a separate 2023 date. Residual cancellation and refill are auxiliary inputs rather than the economic decision rule. It is also distinct from passive maker/queue-fill, generic event-tape, matching-event sweep, cross-venue and movement-hazard studies.
summary: The corrected workflow completed on immutable Bybit BTCUSDT top-five snapshots and trades. Across all 324 frozen candidates, zero had positive mean return at either 12bp or 24bp. The best candidate made only three trades and lost 8.1166bp/trade at 12bp and 20.1166bp/trade at 24bp; its 1%-risk sample-day growth was -1.1047% and -1.7653%. This exact nonlinear taker-payoff dependency is retired without adjacent quantile tuning; 2024-2026 remained unopened.
